name: portfolio-v4
title: Portfolio v4
description: Bash-style terminal portfolio for a fullstack developer — Jon Doe filler career. Type about, work, resume, or help. New projects only (shadcn init --template next).
docs:
New Next.js project only (same flow as https://ui.shadcn.com/create):
  npx shadcn@latest init --template next -y "https://uiception.com/r/portfolio-v4.json"

This scaffolds Next.js + shadcn, then installs the terminal portfolio.

Edit name, bio, projects, experience, and education in lib/portfolio.ts. Common commands: about, work, projects, resume, help. Also on disk (via ls): destinations, events. Colors use the uiception cyan palette (see styles/terminal.css) — aligned with app/vercel-docs-theme.css.
